title: Library group leftovers on four mock pages
goal: A few pages still show an older version of the library panel: an Import button parked in the panel body because its header is missing the add menu, and a category strip that crops the row of items. This brings them back in line with the standard panel.
notes: Objective: design-system > clickthrough-sweep (July findings: verify each is still present first). From study-tasks.json import-header-menu-missing-3-pages + components-page-chrome. (1) img-grade-wt and lang-panels Library groups kept a body Import button because their headers lack the + import menu; give them the standard header menu and delete the body button. (2) components.html adds a bespoke 52px .catrow on top of standard Library chrome so its tile row is cut; fold categories into the scope control. Findings are from July: verify each is still present before fixing.
acceptance: The two pages whose library panel keeps a body Import button get the standard add menu in the header and lose the body button, or the log records that this was already fixed
The components page shows a full, uncropped row of library items with no bespoke category strip, or the log records that this was already fixed
Every touched page loads without error
